label: Figure 1
source_caption: BlueFin is a challenging benchmark for characterizing LLM spreadsheet generation.
caption: Read each column from top to bottom: input, agent, output, grading. Note the three kinds of sample criteria under synthesis and manipulation: a formula check, a value-within-±2% check, and a perturbation check ("if SOFR moves from 2.5% to 3.5%, does interest expense hit the right number?"). Interrogation, by contrast, is auto-graded against a single answer.
